tagline: Warm, cinematic how-tos: your hands shot from above, a black STEP label per step, white captions with one gold italic word.
needs: you at a desk + an overhead shot of your hands (step demo), or a recorded two-person conversation (podcast clip)
readiness_note: Best for food, craft and photography creators who can film their hands from above; the podcast format needs two cameras or one 4K wide.

captions: F-A hook: the finished result in hand, 'This is my morning ritual' with the gold italic word
F-A step: overhead hands, the STEP 2 label tape printing on, then a tool tape
F-B podcast clip: speaker cut, host white and guest cream captions with one gold word
